description: This file defines a Flask route for a health check endpoint, utilizing Flask-Smorest's Blueprint and Flask's MethodView to implement a simple health check returning a JSON message.

classes.name: HealthCheck
classes.description: A Flask view implementing a health check endpoint that responds with a JSON message indicating system health.

methods.name: get(self)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the health check route, returning a JSON object with a 'Healthy' message.

ctags.name: blp
ctags.pattern: /^blp = Blueprint("Health Check", "health", url_prefix="\/", description="Health check route")$/

fields.name: blp = Blueprint("Health Check", "health", url_prefix="\/", description="Health check route")
